topic.source_contract: Digital-connectivity planning, fixed/mobile coverage, operator coordination, building infrastructure and delivery evidence

facts.policy: planning should support electronic communications, 5G and full fibre
facts.guard: national policy support is not a site connection or permission

facts.delivery: provider, local-authority, landowner and developer coordination
facts.guard: programme or rollout resource is not a parcel-specific build commitment

facts.planning: local plans, early engagement and highways coordination
facts.guard: pre-application engagement is not planning approval

facts.building_regulations: Part R physical infrastructure and network-connection requirements
facts.guard: building-regulation provision is not proof of an active service

facts.current: Spring 2026 fixed and mobile coverage update
facts.guard: area coverage statistics are not a premises-level order, wayleave or completed connection

scope_guards: National policy support is not treated as planning permission or prior approval.
Area-level mobile or broadband coverage is not treated as service availability at an exact parcel.
Planned deployment is not treated as committed construction or an activation date.
An operator code right is not treated as a completed wayleave or access agreement.
Part R compliant ducting is not treated as a live network connection.
Planning, highways, street-works and land-right approvals are kept separate.
A provider quotation is not treated as installed and tested service.
No score or promotion is written without exact address coverage, provider design, rights, approvals, build and activation evidence.
